tei:div.tei:p: rje btsun tai lo pa'i lo rgyus/

༄༅/ /slob dpon tai lo pa ni/ shar phyogs tsa ṭi gha bo zhes par yab bram ze pra kā sha dang yum kā shī'i sras su 'khrungs/ bram ze'i lugs kyi bstan bcos thams cad la mkhas par mdzad/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhin mi sdug pa'i mtshan can zhig gis/ gces par bskyangs kyang mi 'chi ba'i// sa phyogs gang na'ang yod ma yin// zer bas/ mi 'chi ba'i thabs dris pas/ ma he skyong zhing yi ge ltos// ḍā ki ma yis lung ston 'gyur// ces zer te mi snang bar gyur to// de nas yang sngar gyi mkha' 'gro ma des/ yul ni shar phyogs dza gor ma yin sogs smras pas/ rab tu byung mtshan shes rab bzang por btags/ sde snod gsum la mkhas par mdzad/ de skabs shar phyogs kyi gtsug lag khang zhig tu bzhugs skabs/ thub dbang gi sku brnyan zhig yod pa'i khri 'og nas 'od dang rol mo'i sgra yang yang byung bas/ brus pas sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi pusti rnyed kyang skabs der zhu ba'i yul ma rnyed/ de nas mkha' 'gros lung bstan te mataṅgi pa btsal bas de ni mi gzhan las nyis 'gyur gyis che ba zhig 'dug par dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor sogs zhus/ bla ma rnam rgyal zhabs dang*/ gu hya pa/ dā ri ka pa/ ḍiṅgi pa/ padma badzra sogs las dkyil 'khor rnams su dbang bskur ba dang*/ phyag rgya chen po/ gtum mo/ 'od gsal/ las rgya ste bka' babs bzhi yi gdams pa dang rgyud bshad sogs zhus nas bsgoms pas ye shes khyad par can skyes te/ klu sgrub dang sa ra ha pa dza landha ri pa sogs grub pa'i skyes bu mtha' yas pa rnams zhal mthong*/ de rnams dang gtam 'dri zhing gdams pa rnams thob/ dpal he ru ka dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams rtag tu zhal mthong nas de rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rkyen gyis ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel bar gyur/ de nas zhing gi rnal 'byor ma til rdung mkhan gyi bu mo zhig dang lhan cig spyod pas dge 'dun rnams kyis gnas nas dbyung bar byas/

grong khyer du til rdung ba'i bya ba mdzad pas sngar bram ze dge slong du gyur pa'i rnyed bkur chen po yod pa'ang nyams te til rdung ma'i bdag po yin pas phal skad tillu pa dang*/ legs sbyar tai lo pa ste til rdung mkhan zhes ming 'gyur ro// gang zhig snying por gyur pa til gyi mar// lhan cig skyes pa gnyug ma'i ye shes te// 'gro ba kun gyi snying la yod na'ang*// bla mas ma mtshon rtogs par mi nus so// zhes sogs dang*/ kye ho ring du 'gro 'dod gting dpag dka' ba'i don// da lta nyid du gsal ba ngo mtshar che// ces gsungs te/ til las til mar 'byung ba bzhin/ bla ma'i man ngag gis lus la gnad du bsnun pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'byung ba sogs bya ba thams cad kyis rang la ngo sprad par song ste mchog gi dngos grub thob bo/ /de dag gi skabs rnams su yul sna tshogs su spyod cing gnas pas/ o rgyan du byon pas bud med sngon mo mkha' 'gro'i mtshan can zhig dang 'phrad pas/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i brda bstan pas des kyang brda'i lan byas te skad cig gis sgrol mar gyur nas dbang bskur rgyud gtad pas sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi bdag por gyur cing des nā' ro pa la bshad do/ /de la sogs mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi gdams pa thams cad thob/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal gcig car mthong ngo*/ /der rtogs pa gsungs pa/ nga lus dgyes pa rdo rje ste// ngag ni sgyu ma chen po yin// sems ni bde mchog 'khor lo yin// dbang po gsang ba 'dus pa nyid// yan lag dus dgra nag po ste// nying lag rdo rje 'jigs mdzad che// ces sogs gsungs so// gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa ma ti zhes pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal can zhig nus pas skyengs par mdzad de gdams pa bstan pas grub pa thob ste/ kriṣṇa shu bha zhes da lta'ang bsil ba tshal du bzhugs so/ /bhaṃ ga lar sgyu ma mkhan slu byed kyis sgyu ma'i dmag gis grong khyer gyi rgyal phran 'ga' zhig bros su nye bar byas pa mkha' 'gro mas bskul nas der byon/

sgyu ma mkhan gyi sgyu ma nus pas bshig ste/ grong khyer pa rgyal po sgyu ma mkhan bcas la gdams pa bstan te thams cad 'ja' lus su song*/ mnyan yod du chang 'tshong ma nyi 'od ces pa'i chang thams cad them shor nas med par byas pa na de rab tu 'gyod pas slar sngar gyi chang las brgya 'gyur gyis bzang zhing mang bar mdzad pas chang 'tshong ma de dad nas gdams pa zhus pas rnal 'byor ma chen mor gyur te sgron ma 'dzin zhes grags/ byang phyogs su shan pa zhig gi bu de shan pa'i 'tshed snod du 'tshod pa'i cho 'phrul mdzad pas kho rang shin tu 'gyod par/ bu gsos te byin pas dad nas gdams pa zhus pas grub pa thob/ na ga rar glu mkhan zhig glu len pas skyengs par mdzad pas kho shin tu dad de gdams pa zhus nas dbyangs ldan zhes bya ba'i grub thob tu gyur/ yang lho phyogs na rgyang phan gyi grub mtha' dar bas de'i bla ma dzi na bya ba na bza' la bzung bcug ste dmyal gnas su khrid nas kho rang 'tshed snod kyi dmyal zangs mthong ba dang las mkhan rnams la skad dris pas de ltar yin pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad pas kho rang las 'bras la yid ches te/ gdams pa zhus nas rnal 'byor bar gyur to/ /pa ṭa li pu ṭar/ mu stegs byed mthu mkhan zhig la tshig gis sun phyung bas/ kho rang khros nas mthu byas pas nye du thams cad kha btag /yi chad pas/ nye du rnams gsos nas gtad pas kho dad de gdams pa zhus pas grub thob nyi zla 'dzin zhes par gyur/ de la sogs pa 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i rnam thar ni ches mang mod 'dir de tsam mo/ /de nas rang gi rtogs pa de gzhan la ston par bzhed nas dus gzhan zhig na/ grong khyer gyi tshong 'dus rnams suu rtogs pa glur blangs pas skye bo thams cad the tshom du gyur/ lan cig bhaṅga la'i grong khyer du skye bo brgya stong du ma slob dpon la ltar 'ong ba na/ slob dpon rig ma dang bcas bar snang du bzhugs nas til rdung bzhin du bzhugs par/

mi res dri ba re zhus pas/ lan du rtogs pa'i glu re blangs pas der 'tshogs pa'i skye bo phal cher gyis don rtogs nas dngos grub thob/ yun ring du 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du bzhud pa yin no//
